title: As You Like It Section 5 — Warm-up, Story Summary, Reading Extracts and Character Actions
summary: Teacher's guide for Section 5 of As You Like It with objectives to read for pleasure and develop vocabulary. Includes a warmer activity on prior events, reading a story summary, reading literary extracts for gist with multiple-choice questions, and a true/false task on characters' actions.

title: As You Like It Section 5 — Sequencing Events and Writing a Letter from Oliver
summary: Completes the sequence-ordering answer key for Section 5 and presents Stage 7, a group writing task where students imagine Oliver writing a letter to Frederick about events between him and his brother Orlando, then share and display their letters.

title: As You Like It Section 6 — Warm-up, Story Summary, True/False Reading and Character Matching
summary: Teacher's guide for Section 6 of As You Like It with objectives to read for pleasure and develop vocabulary. Includes a warmer, reading a story summary about celebrations, reading literary extracts with true/false questions, and a matching activity on the characters of the play.

title: As You Like It Section 6 — Letter Writing: Duke Frederick Tells His Brother of Becoming a Holy Man
summary: Provides the matching-task answer key for Section 6 and outlines Stage 7, a group writing activity where students imagine Duke Frederick writing a letter to his brother about his decision to become a holy man, sharing drafts and displaying the best ones.
